# openwrt_firewall_rule (Resource)

A traffic rule (`config rule`). Use `openwrt_uci_order` when rule order matters.

Manages a `rule` section in `/etc/config/firewall`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `dest` (String) Destination zone (`*` for any, empty for input). (UCI option `dest`.)
- `dest_ip` (List of String) Destination addresses. (UCI option `dest_ip`.)
- `dest_port` (String) Destination ports. (UCI option `dest_port`.)
- `device` (String) Match device. (UCI option `device`.)
- `direction` (String) Direction for `device`. (UCI option `direction`.) One of: `in`, `out`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the rule. (UCI option `enabled`.)
- `extra` (String) Extra raw match arguments. (UCI option `extra`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `family` (String) Address family. (UCI option `family`.) One of: `ipv4`, `ipv6`, `any`.
- `icmp_type` (List of String) ICMP types. (UCI option `icmp_type`.)
- `ipset` (String) Match an ipset (`!` to negate). (UCI option `ipset`.)
- `limit` (String) Rate limit, e.g. `10/second`. (UCI option `limit`.)
- `limit_burst` (Number) Rate limit burst. (UCI option `limit_burst`.)
- `mark` (String) Match firewall mark. (UCI option `mark`.)
- `monthdays` (String) Days of month. (UCI option `monthdays`.)
- `name` (String) Descriptive name. (UCI option `name`.)
- `proto` (List of String) Protocols (`tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `all`, ...). (UCI option `proto`.)
- `set_dscp` (String) DSCP target: value. (UCI option `set_dscp`.)
- `set_helper` (String) HELPER target: helper. (UCI option `set_helper`.)
- `set_mark` (String) MARK target: set mark. (UCI option `set_mark`.)
- `set_xmark` (String) MARK target: xor mark. (UCI option `set_xmark`.)
- `src` (String) Source zone (`*` for any). (UCI option `src`.)
- `src_ip` (List of String) Source addresses. (UCI option `src_ip`.)
- `src_mac` (List of String) Source MAC addresses. (UCI option `src_mac`.)
- `src_port` (String) Source ports. (UCI option `src_port`.)
- `start_date` (String) Start date `YYYY-MM-DD`. (UCI option `start_date`.)
- `start_time` (String) Start time `hh:mm:ss`. (UCI option `start_time`.)
- `stop_date` (String) Stop date `YYYY-MM-DD`. (UCI option `stop_date`.)
- `stop_time` (String) Stop time `hh:mm:ss`. (UCI option `stop_time`.)
- `target` (String) Action. (UCI option `target`.) One of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`, `MARK`, `NOTRACK`, `HELPER`, `DSCP`.
- `utc_time` (Boolean) Times are UTC. (UCI option `utc_time`.)
- `weekdays` (String) Weekdays, e.g. `Mon Tue`. (UCI option `weekdays`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
